# `cargo cicd status show`

Displays the current workspace status: dirty files, pending tests, last-known trybuild result, and publish readiness. Read-only; emits a StatusShowEvent.

**Noun:** `status` &nbsp;&nbsp; **Verb:** `show`

<!-- END ggen:command-reference -->

<!-- BEGIN custom:examples -->
## Examples

```sh
cargo cicd status show
```
